plugin.name: OpenAI
plugin.description: Text and image generation via any OpenAI-compatible endpoint (OpenAI, Azure, vLLM, Ollama, LM Studio).

env.description: Key for the target OpenAI-compatible endpoint
Optional: force a chat model id (advanced; the per-node model picker is the normal way)
Optional: force an image model id (advanced; overridden by the per-node picker)
Force an image size (e.g. 1024x1024 / auto); defaults to the node's size
